text:
maria: Quick note — spotted a PII leak in the node sampleapp logs when running with LOG_LEVEL=debug. Request IDs repeat and redactor shows 'skipped'.

sam: Can you repro locally? which node version and sampleapp tag?

maria: node 18.16, sampleapp@1.4.7. Repro script at /scripts/high-concurrency.sh; around 30 concurrent clients you see duplicate reqids.

lee: paste snippet and middleware order pls. otel-hook ordering historically bites us.

maria: snippet:
```
INFO reqid=xyz123 payload={"email":"bob@example.com"}
ERROR reqid=xyz123 stack="Error: fail"
DEBUG reqid=xyz123 redactor=skipped payload={"phone":"+1555000"}
```
middleware:```js
app.use(require('./reqid'))
app.use(require('./otel-hook'))
app.use(require('./redactor'))
```

ash: likely asyncLocalStorage stomp from otel-hook or somemetrics. Two fixes: move otel-hook before reqid or use als.run in reqid to pin context.

sam: also add a metric when redactor sees no reqid (volatile_reqid) so Optimize/alerts catch it. Don't silently regenerate without telemetry.

lee: agreed. minimal change: in reqid middleware do `als.run(new Map([['reqid', reqid]]), next)` and in redactor if no reqid emit metric and redact anyway.

maria: opened PR #1301 with middleware reorder, als.run, volatile_reqid metric, and an e2e that asserts no raw emails/phones under load.

jen: QA can validate in staging once PR merges. Recommend temporary mitigation: set LOG_LEVEL=info on Dedicated.

ci-bot: sampleapp/staging v1.4.7 deployed -> build 8881 succeeded :white_check_mark:

sam: will review PR today. Also add a linter rule to forbid direct asyncLocalStorage.enterWith in libs. catches regressions.

maria: will add linter + integ test that simulates a lib calling enterWith. Thanks all.
